results.title: INTJ — The Strategist
results.summary: Strategic and future-oriented, INTJs enjoy building models to solve complex problems. They value competence, autonomy, and clarity of purpose.
results.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an INTJ. I'm a systems thinker who enjoys turning complexity into strategy. I have high standards for competence and I prefer independence and efficiency. I value clear logic and long‑term planning, and I'm motivated by solving challenging problems. I can come across as reserved, but I'm deeply committed to ideas that make a difference. I thrive when I'm building and optimizing frameworks that last.

My top need is Growth. I'm driven to improve. Learning new skills and stretching my capabilities give me momentum and purpose. When this need isn't met, I tend to feel stagnant, frustrated, disengaged. My secondary need is Love & Connection. I thrive on closeness and belonging. Warm relationships, empathy, and shared moments help me feel grounded and seen. Together, these shape my decisions and habits. Growth 28% · Love & Connection 24% · Contribution 18% · Certainty 12% · Variety 10% · Significance 8%

results.display: Primary: Quality Time • Secondary: Words of Affirmation
results.firstPerson: My primary love language is Quality Time. I feel most loved when we share focused time—unhurried conversations, eye contact, and being fully present together. My secondary love language is Words of Affirmation. I feel most loved when appreciation is spoken or written—specific encouragement, thoughtful notes, and genuine verbal support. Quality Time 35% · Words of Affirmation 28% · Acts of Service 15% · Physical Touch 12% · Receiving Gifts 10%
